# Status page

This site is a status page built with Yet Another Status Page. Current service status, incidents and maintenance windows are available in machine-readable form.

## Public API (read-only, no authentication)

- OpenAPI 3.1 specification: /api/v1/openapi.json
- Current overall status, services, unresolved incidents, upcoming maintenances: /api/v1/status
- Incidents: /api/v1/incidents (filter with ?status=active)
- Maintenances: /api/v1/maintenances (filter with ?status=active)
- Services: /api/v1/services

All timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC. Errors are RFC 9457 problem details.

## Feeds

- Atom feed of incident and maintenance updates: /feed.atom
- iCalendar feed of maintenance windows: /maintenances.ics

## Documentation

- https://docs.yasp.io/api/overview.html
